messages:
nina: Quick RFC sketch: add tenant-level burst credits for debug retention so teams can temporarily retain more prefixes without changing global tiers. Helps on chase-the-bug incidents. Proposal: default 1 burst credit = 1MB retained, admin can grant up to N credits for T hours. Thoughts?
harry: I like it. Two concerns: billing separation (must not be counted as normal token usage) and UI discoverability. :mag_right:
claire: UX: show credits balance on tenant page and in route request detail. When a burst is used show a yellow pill: 'burst-used' with TTL. Provide "request emergency credit" flow that opens a ticket.
mike: Implementation note: retention middleware should check {route_tier, tenant_enabled, burst_balance}. If burst_balance>0, allow one-off override up to burst_size (configurable). On use decrement balance and emit metric retention.burst.used.
nina: Example config (draft):
```json
{
  "burst_credits": {
    "default_balance": 1,
    "credit_unit_bytes": 1048576,
    "max_grant": 10,
    "expiry_hours": 48
  },
  "retention_tiers": {
    "public": {"prefix_bytes": 64, "ttl_hours": 6},
    "partner": {"prefix_bytes": 128, "ttl_hours": 24},
    "admin": {"prefix_bytes": 256, "ttl_hours": 72, "breakglass": true}
  }
}
```
harry: Security: burst credits must not bypass HMAC/pseudonymization rules. Any retained prefix must still be pseudonymized for high-cardinality fields and embeddings must be stripped. Also keep KMS-backed tenant keys and rotation.
claire: UX follow-up: if a request used a burst credit show a short explanation tooltip and a link to the audit entry. Also add a two-step confirmation when granting credits in Console (SSO + reason).
audit-bot: audit: create entry when credit granted or used. Fields: actor, tenant, amount, reason, request_id, ttl.
sec-bot: security-scan: flagged missing RBAC gating for grant flow and missing KMS rotation policy. Create ticket SEC-6120.
mike: Ops: add alerts when remaining total burst pool across tenants falls below 10%. Also add metric retention.burst.denied when tenant has 0 balance. On deny fallback to normal tier (no extra retention).
nina: Edge case: what if a tenant repeatedly burns credits? We should have an automated rate limit that pauses granting until manual review. Also require email confirmation to customer for any manual grant > X credits.
harry: Agree. Also include a 'revoke credit' workflow in case of misuse. Revoke must purge ephemeral blobs created by those credits if within TTL? Probably better to mark as revoked and prevent further access; purging might require legal. Need SEC input.
claire: I'll mock Console panels: tenant credit balance, grant modal, per-request badge and a small timeline view showing when credits were consumed.
mike: I'll prototype middleware + metric emission and a small e2e that ensures billing unaffected. Plan canary to a tiny pool after SEC ticket addressed.
nina: If no objections I'll open RFC PR with tests: burst accounting, cap enforcement, pseudonymization enforcement, audit entries. Will include SEC-6120.
harry: sgtm.
sec-bot: note: include KMS rotation plan and RBAC matrix in PR.
audit-bot: thread closed by nina
